steps.caption: Click Guard
steps.narration: This is Click Guard. It records the visits your tracking code sees, and flags repeat and bot clicks.

steps.caption: Pick the website
steps.narration: Pick the website. This roofing company protects three.

steps.caption: Visits, blocked, unique
steps.narration: For the range you pick, the Dashboard counts visits, blocked IPs and unique visitors.

steps.caption: Threat level
steps.narration: Threat level is the share of those visits that were flagged.

steps.caption: The visit trend
steps.narration: The visit trend shows each day's visits, so a spike stands out.

steps.caption: Traffic signals
steps.narration: Choose Traffic signals, where the flagged traffic lives, with Blocked IPs first.

steps.caption: Blocked IPs, with the reason
steps.narration: Blocked IPs lists each address with its reason: a bot user agent, too many visits an hour, or one device on many IPs.

steps.caption: Blocked on its own
steps.narration: A flagged IP that passes ten visits in an hour is blocked on its own.

steps.caption: Block an IP yourself
steps.narration: Block an address yourself: a single IP, a range or a wildcard, and unblock any of them.

steps.caption: Every visit
steps.narration: Below, the Clicks report lists every visit: IP, device, browser, page and status, with a Block button on each.

steps.caption: Google Ads script
steps.narration: Google Ads script turns the list into IP exclusions: paste one script into your Ads account and schedule it hourly.

steps.caption: Ready to sync
steps.narration: It shows how many IPs are ready to sync, against Google's limit of five hundred per campaign.

steps.caption: Menu: Click Guard
steps.narration: You'll find Click Guard in the menu on the left, under Google Ads.

youtube.description: A one-minute tour of Click Guard in ConstructHUB: the visits your tracking code records, the ones flagged as repeat or bot clicks, blocked IPs with the reason for each, the daily visit trend, and the Google Ads script that turns the list into IP exclusions.
